synthesized_findings: Multi-agent observability requires a governed event vocabulary, durable ingest, session boundaries, and queryable correlation fields.
The parent should care primarily about event schema, durability, and promotion-time review, not about the exact dashboard technology.
A blocked or fixture-only lane is more truthful than a report that implies live telemetry without a running sink.
doctrine_implications: Keep event and ingest contracts separate so emitters and sinks can evolve independently.
Require session start/end and stop evidence whenever observability is used as promotion proof.
Allow local fixture or dry evidence, but label it clearly instead of implying live visibility.
unresolved_ambiguities: The local Notion docs define report classes but do not preserve detailed event schemas; those details currently come from the upstream repo.
